inputs.name: SocketAcceptService.constructor.store
inputs.description: Provides the stored host record and device records consulted during credential validation. The service reads the host record before hashing credentials and re-reads it before comparing the presented hash; device claims are checked against the stored device credential hash.

inputs.name: SocketAcceptService.constructor.sockets
inputs.description: Provides the active host socket, sockets for a device, and new socket pairs for accepted connections. A host connection replaces the previous host socket, while device connections are replaced per device ID.

inputs.name: SocketAcceptService.constructor.link
inputs.description: Applies link side effects after credential validation succeeds: it drops replaced sockets, welcomes the host, marks a device seen, and sends a device-open notice to the host. The host path sends the welcome after opening the new socket, while the device path announces the new connection ID.

inputs.name: SocketAcceptService.constructor.rate
inputs.description: Counts failed connects with the connect scope and relayConfig.failedConnects threshold when a host record exists. Once the limit is reached, invalid credentials receive 429; missing-host requests return 401 without calling the rate limiter.

inputs.name: SocketAcceptService.accept.request
inputs.description: Carries the Upgrade header and connect claims used by the service to authenticate a WebSocket connection. Requests without a WebSocket upgrade, valid claims, a host record, or a current matching credential are refused with an HTTP error response.

outputs.name: SocketAcceptService.accept
outputs.description: Resolves to the HTTP response for the attempt: 426 for a non-WebSocket upgrade, 401 or 429 for refused credentials, or 101 with the accepted WebSocket. The 429 response is used after the host's failed-connect limit is exceeded; a valid credential is not refused due to other failures.
